Workspace-aware Kain shell with page-level docks, stage decks, and authored operator rails.

SCENE ASSEMBLY
Scene-first assembly and ingest mission control
Stage layout, intake, placement, and downstream review stay in one operator surface instead of scattering across separate host-owned tools.
Select | Selection, hierarchy filtering, and transform handoff.
Kitbash Placement | Scene placement, snap rules, and collection instancing.
Bootstrap Suite | Seeds the canonical scene, asset, preview, tensor, and publish session state.
Switch Workspace | Moves the operator into a different DCC lane and marks downstream surfaces for refresh.
Ingest Package | Stages a new asset package into the suite ingest lane and updates runtime pack bookkeeping.
Render Preview | Stages a preview render refresh and updates render-facing reports.

Viewport-dominant modeling and sculpt layout
Brush operations, topology refresh, and publish invalidation are grouped as one sculpt workbench instead of separate one-off inspectors.

Clay Sculpt | Brush-based form sculpting through the native mutation seam.
Voxel Rebuild | Topology reset, remesh, and high-level volume cleanup.
Activate Tool | Changes the active authoring tool and updates tool preset context.
Set Selection | Replaces the live entity selection and updates lane inspectors.
Apply Sculpt Stroke | Queues a sculpt stroke through the native mutation seam and marks downstream lanes dirty.
Rebuild Topology | Refreshes topology and graph health analysis against current scene resources.
